Early Warning is a desktop early-warning dashboard for the UK and the US. It runs quietly in the system tray, checks about 40 free public feeds every few minutes and shows them on one screen: official weather warnings, floods and tides, wildfires (US), power cuts, the electricity grid and gas, local news and roads, world flashpoints, disasters, health alerts, money and shipping, space weather and cyber. New serious alerts pop up as notifications.

Enter your UK postcode or US ZIP code on first run and it picks the right weather warnings, flood and tide gauges, power data and local news for where you live. Nothing is sent anywhere except requests to the public feeds themselves.

Downloads:
- Windows: Early-Warning-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe (installer) or Early-Warning-Portable-{{VERSION}}.exe (no install)
- Mac: Early-Warning-{{VERSION}}-mac-arm64.zip (Apple silicon) or -mac-x64.zip (Intel)
- Linux: Early-Warning-{{VERSION}}.AppImage

The apps aren't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC": click More info, then Run anyway. On a Mac, right-click the app and choose Open the first time. Checksums are in SHA256SUMS.txt.
